description: We welcome you to our charming apartment in the center of Paris: Very bright, very quiet, it's a duplex with a bedroom, TV room, kitchen and dining area; upstairs, a Japanese room that can accommodate two people on futons and tatami mats. The upper level opens onto a terrace with a beautiful view of Paris. Additional photos on requestNote: The apartment is on the top floor of the building (5), with no elevator. But it's worth it!The spaceIn the lower part of the apartment : - Queen size bedroom- 2-seater confortable sofa bedIn the upper part : - Two individual futons with extra mat for extra confort Bed linen and towels are provided. There is a washing and drying machine. Laundry detergent is provided.The kitchen is fully equipped, with all the usual products at your disposal. Bathroom products are provided, as is a hairdryer.Guest access5 min from Réaumur subway station and 3 min from Arts et Métiers station. You have access to the whole apartment. Bed linen and towels are provided. There is a washing and drying machine. Laundry detergent is provided.The kitchen is fully equipped, with all the usual products at your disposal. Bathroom products are provided, as is a hairdryer.Other things to noteThis is not a professional rental, this is our home, so please respect our things, empty closet are at your disposal of course =)
